# ThrowPot

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** ThrowPot

## What it does

Automatically throws 1-2 throw-able healing potions depending on health when toggled.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Vape — ThrowPot](https://www.vape.gg/index.php/features)

Throws or consumes healing items upon using keybind

Basis: [publisher description](https://www.vape.gg/index.php/features).

### [Future — ThrowPot](https://www.futureclient.net/#features)

Automatically throws 1-2 throw-able healing potions depending on health when toggled.

Basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features).
